capabilities.text: Automatically sync a saved fall risk assessment from Cerner to CarePath without nurse confirmation
Validate nursing note data on entry in Cerner and block sync if validation fails
Log all API calls and sync attempts with detailed audit trails in Azure Monitor
Expose a single secured REST API endpoint for nursing notes integration, protected by Azure AD OAuth 2.0
Transform HL7 v2.5.1 messages from Cerner into FHIR R4 Observation resources for CarePath ingestion
Enforce encryption of all data in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256 with customer-managed keys)
Provide ward-scoped, read-only access for clinical informatics analysts to view full payloads and errors in Azure Monitor
Provide full administrative access for IT operations administrators to manage infrastructure, logs, and configurations
Display no notification to nurses on successful sync; show inline non-modal warning in Cerner on sync failure
Automatically retry transient sync failures every 5 minutes for up to 30 minutes before escalating alerts
Allow nurses to manually trigger a retry of a transient sync failure from within Cerner without re-entering data
Replace previous CarePath observation with the latest saved note from Cerner, not keep multiple versions
Retain last successfully synced observation in CarePath if a subsequent save fails validation
Enforce data residency within the U.S. West Central Azure region with Azure Policy compliance controls
Include a required FHIR Observation context extension referencing the Cerner encounter ID in every payload
Filter analyst access to patient data by ward using Azure AD role-based access control with claims-based filtering
Provide a single Azure Monitor screen for analysts showing patient ID, timestamp, error message, raw HL7, and full FHIR payload
Log manual retry attempts with a manual_retry flag and timestamp in audit logs
Alert analysts immediately on validation failures without retrying
Support high availability and scale with AKS cluster auto-scaling and Azure API Management premium tier with rate limiting
